model.limitation: The historical generation-model comparison uses the OpenAI retrieval profile; its GPT-5.4 generation trade-off is directional evidence and the passing BGE quality report remains authoritative for the selected profile.

retrieval.limitation: The historical three-mode retrieval comparison uses OpenAI embeddings and reranking, so it demonstrates the required alternatives but does not substitute for the selected BGE profile quality gate.

cache.limitation: The historical cache comparison has incomplete paired candidate evidence and no recommendation; official performance traffic therefore bypasses cache and no cache benefit is claimed.

selection_rationale.model: GPT-5.4 is retained because the selected BGE configuration passes every mandatory advanced bilingual quality gate; the historical model comparison supplies directional latency and cost trade-offs.
selection_rationale.retrieval: Hybrid parent-child retrieval combines bilingual semantic recall with exact-identifier lexical matching and returns bounded parent context.
selection_rationale.reranker: The local BGE cross-encoder is enabled in the passing selected configuration to improve top-context ordering after hybrid candidate fusion.
selection_rationale.cache: Official performance traffic bypasses retrieval cache for attributable measurements; no cache-performance benefit is claimed because historical paired cache evidence is incomplete.

local.hardware: NVIDIA RTX 2000 Ada Generation Laptop GPU (8 GiB), declared workstation allocation

limitations: The 100-request single-instance sample is MVP evidence and is not a production capacity guarantee.
The local BGE cost uses a declared USD 0.50 per GPU-hour workstation allocation rate and the measured load duration.
Historical comparison reports are partial cross-profile supporting evidence and are not used for mandatory quality, performance, or cost gates.
Evaluation-only judge cost is unavailable and is not represented as zero.
